description: Discover La Villa les Pins, a haven of peace in Versailles: 260 m², 4 bedrooms with private bathrooms, a landscaped garden of 1000 m² and a heated swimming pool. Only a 10-minute walk from the Château and 8 minutes from the train station to Paris (12 minutes to Montparnasse, direct access to La Défense and the Eiffel Tower). Ideal for 8 people, stays or filming. Combine high-end comfort, nature and strategic location in an elegant and serene setting. Private parking included.The spaceDiscover this exceptional 260 m² villa, nestled in a green setting in Versailles. Ideally located in a confidential location, the villa combines high-end comfort and strategic location.For more information, visit the lesdemoisellesaversailles website.Just a few minutes' walk from the Palace of Versailles and public transport, enjoy quick access to Paris Montparnasse, La Défense and the great Parisian boulevards. The RER takes you directly to iconic sites such as the Eiffel Tower.Featuring 4 spacious bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, the villa can accommodate up to 8 people in an intimate and modern atmosphere.The vast 1000 m² garden with its majestic pine trees and swimming pool offers an ideal setting to relax in the middle of nature, while remaining close to amenities.Whether for an unforgettable stay or a unique shoot, La Villa des Pins is the promise of a quiet and elegant setting, where nature and comfort meet.Highlights:A heated pool with counter-current swimming, perfect for relaxing and enjoying the sunny days7 min drive to the Palace of Versailles – 10 min walk8-minute walk from Versailles Chantiers train station to Paris – Direct access to Montparnasse in 12 minutesRER C, direct line to central ParisArrival at Saint-Lazare in 35 minutesArrive at La Défense in 15 minute
